risks: Staging DamageModifier 9.5 raises Maloriak's 10N melee from 4.6-6.8k to 43.7-64.9k per swing (U stage) every ~1.8 s. That is Blizzlike, but it is a large jump in tank and healer pressure compared with every earlier Maloriak run, including full-route r11. Expect the first staged batch to test the Blood DK and the healers.

The phase-two cadence change (Magma Jets 6->11.8 s, Acid Nova 20->30.7 s, Absolute Zero 7->11.3 s, first Absolute Zero 8.4->11.3 s) makes phase two less punishing and applies to all modes (the script has no mode branch). Only 10N was observed. It needs the coordinator build and review, and changes the full-route Maloriak node versus r11.

WCL targets now replace the WoWSims fallback for several specs: demonology_warlock moves from WoWSims 38,038 x 0.90 to WCL 18,229.8 x 0.95, and survival_hunter is median(25,375.4, 16,145.0) = 20,760.2. feral_druid_tank 16,202.0 comes from a Guardian who tanked Maloriak, while the bot's Feral tanks adds, so that target may be high for an add tank.
